title: Materializar superficie genérica texto → audio sobre backend existente
mission: Create an isolated candidate paste-text-to-audio UI by reusing the already deployed audio-lab-page-audio-v1 backend and existing Audio Lab publication pattern. Do not create another TTS backend, do not replace the six-voice comparison lab, and do not promote the candidate to Current/Human Accepted/Served.
definition_of_done: An isolated browser-openable candidate surface accepts pasted text and one selected or fixed voice design and clearly enforces the backend 1800-character ceiling.
Generation uses only the existing audio-lab-page-audio-v1 endpoint with a deterministic messageId suitable for cache reuse; no new TTS generation backend is introduced.
The UI truthfully distinguishes generating, cache reuse, playable audio and errors, without showing a playing state before audio actually starts.
The surface explicitly discloses that generation is remote/cloud-backed through Supabase/Qwen rather than local-only.

A verification receipt records exact candidate path/URL, static publication evidence, and at least one non-destructive request-path test or a precise external-generation boundary if a live generation is intentionally not invoked.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, catalog authority or production /w pointer is changed.
